description: Enabling CLI test coverage no longer plants an empty `.strictcli/coverage/` directory in whatever directory you run the CLI from. The directory is now created only when a test actually records coverage.

**The project describes itself consistently everywhere.** The PyPI page now carries one canonical one-line description covering all three implementations instead of a Python-only summary, alongside documentation, repository, issue and changelog links, real discovery keywords, and console/OS-independent classifiers.
